results_section.claim: 5. Golden Validation: 76.9% pass rate (10/13 tests within ±10% tolerance)
results_section.explanation: Execution stage: The golden validation requires data_proc/golden_set.parquet which does not exist. The only available related dataset (golden_drugs.csv) shows values that completely contradict the implicit 'actual' values needed to produce the claimed 76.9% pass rate. Three of the five tested drugs (Mounjaro, Trikafta, Verzenio, accounting for 9/13 tests) do not appear in golden_drugs.csv. For the two drugs that do appear (Repatha, Ibrance), the real CSV values differ drastically from the values that would be needed to yield the claimed result. The 76.9% claim can only be reproduced if the parquet file uses fabricated actual values specifically crafted to pass 10/13 tests, not real pharmaceutical data.
